k:種.mnemonic: The grain (禾) growing in your hometown (里) today is the same kind your grandparents sowed yesterday (昨), saved and replanted year after year. Species (kind, class, variety).

k:故.mnemonic: You idly strike (攵) an old (古) wall with a stick as you pass. A brick falls out, and behind it sits a pot of coins. Pure chance. Happenstance (reason, cause, intentionally).
k:故.hint: Tapping an old wall, finding coins.

k:則.mnemonic: At the market each shellfish (貝) is laid against a notch cut by knife (刂) into the counter. Smaller than the notch, and it goes back in the sea. Rule (law, follow, based on).

k:側.mnemonic: The leader (亻) reads out the rule (則) and everyone must pick: those who agree stand to his left, the rest to his right. Side (lean, oppose, regret).
k:側.hint: Standing to his left or right.

k:橋.mnemonic: Two villages facing (向) each other across a river fell a tall tree (木) so that it lands on the far bank, and walk across. Bridge.

k:唱.mnemonic: Every day (日) the pupil opens his mouth (口) and says the same verses aloud, until he knows them by heart. Recite (chant, call upon, yell).

k:昭.mnemonic: The knight holds up his sword (刀) to recite (唱) his oath, and the polished blade catches the sun and flashes across the hall. Shining (bright, brightness, light).

k:隊.mnemonic: Over the mound (阝) comes pig (豕) after pig, marching in step with snouts level, like soldiers on parade. Regiment (party, company, squad).

k:束.mnemonic: Branches cut from a tree (木), tied tight round the middle with cord, and stacked for shipping all across Asia (亜). Bundle (sheaf, ream, tie in bundles).

k:速.mnemonic: The courier ties the letters into one bundle (束), tucks it under his arm and sprints down the path (辶) without stopping. Quick (fast).

k:舟.mnemonic: A little hull seen from above: curved sides, a plank seat across the middle, and an oar poking out to each side. Boat (ship).

k:票.mnemonic: The sheriff of a town out west (西) asks everyone to show (示) which candidate they want by dropping a marked slip in the box. Ballot (label, ticket, sign).
k:票.hint: Marked slips dropped in a box.

k:船.mnemonic: A boat (舟) so large that a great mouth (口) of a cargo hatch opens in its deck to swallow crates by the dozen. Ship (boat).

k:存.mnemonic: A child (子) asks ten thousand (万) questions a day. You do not really know the answers, so each time you shrug and say 'I guess so'. Suppose (exist, be aware of, believe).
k:存.hint: Endless questions, answered with a shrug.

k:赤.mnemonic: Soil on top, and below it a fire with sparks jumping out to each side: earth baked in the kiln until it glows. Red.

k:断.mnemonic: A landslide drops a hill (丘) across the only road and the rice (米) carts cannot get through. The village's supply is cut clean off. Severance (decline, refuse, warn).

k:好.mnemonic: A woman (女) holding her child (子) close, cheek to cheek. Nothing in the world is dearer to her. Fond (pleasing, like something).

k:供.mnemonic: The villagers carry their gifts up together (共) and lay them at the feet of the leader (亻), who nods and accepts. Submit (offer, present, accompany).

k:良.mnemonic: Stubborn (艮) with a gold star pinned on top: the pupil who stubbornly kept at it until the work came out right. Good (pleasing, skilled).
k:良.hint: Gold star for not giving up.

k:処.mnemonic: You pick up the rubbish piled on the table (几), trudge (夂) out to the bin with it, and the problem is dealt with. Dispose (manage, deal with, sentence).
k:処.hint: Clearing the mess, out to the bin.

k:追.mnemonic: The thief bolts down the middle (中) of the path (辶) and you run right behind him, never letting him out of your sight. Chase (follow, pursue, drive away).

k:列.mnemonic: A museum keeper scrapes each of the dinosaur's bones (歹) clean with a knife (刂) and lays them out one behind another, from nose to tail. File (row, rank, column).
k:列.hint: Skeleton laid out nose to tail.

k:残.mnemonic: After the feast the guard pokes through the plates with his halberd (戈) and finds nothing but bones (歹). That is all there is left. Remainder (leftover, balance).

k:洋.mnemonic: Water as far as the eye can see, a tsunami (氵) of it, and the whitecaps running across it look like a flock of sheep (羊). Ocean (sea, foreign, Western style).

k:必.mnemonic: Put a child at the top of a slide (ノ) and their heart (心) leaps on the way down. Every child, every time, without fail. Invariably (certain, inevitable).

k:消.mnemonic: The last sparkle (⺌) of a campfire that was kept burning for a month (月) vanishes under a tsunami (氵) of water from the bucket. Extinguish (blow out, turn off, cancel).
k:消.hint: Bucket of water on the embers.

k:黄.mnemonic: A scarecrow standing in a ripe field: wide arms at the top, a square straw-stuffed body, two little legs, the whole thing the colour of corn. Yellow.

k:横.mnemonic: A cart of yellow (黄) fruit (果) left in the sun all day (日) takes a corner too fast. It tips over, and twenty (廾) melons roll off across the road. Sideways (side, horizontal, width).
k:横.hint: Melon cart tipping on a corner.

k:師.mnemonic: The master has trained all over Asia (亜), and all he carries is a towel (巾) round his neck. He wipes his brow and shows you how it is done. Expert (teacher, master, model).
